list.name: LoadId
list.label: Lote
list.query: select LoadId from TestLoad where Status = 'Succeeded' order by CreatedAt desc

list.name: Environment
list.label: Ambiente
list.query: select distinct Environment from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' union select distinct Environment from Application where ApplicationId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by Environment

list.name: HostName
list.label: Equipo
list.query: select distinct HostName from (select mr.Name as HostName, coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') as Environment from MonitoredResource mr join CapacityKpi k on k.ResourceId = mr.ResourceId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = mr.Name and c.LoadId = coalesce(k.LoadId, substring(k.CapacityKpiId from '^(.+)-Kpi-')) where coalesce(k.LoadId, substring(k.CapacityKpiId from '^(.+)-Kpi-')) ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' union select ComponentName as HostName, Environment from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})') Hosts where Environment ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' order by HostName

list.name: ServiceId
list.label: Servicio/Subsistema
list.query: select distinct ServiceId from (select m.ServiceId, coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') as Environment from ServiceResourceMap m left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = m.ResourceId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = mr.Name and c.LoadId = substring(m.MapId from '^(.+)-Map-') where m.MapId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' union select BusinessServiceId as ServiceId, Environment from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and BusinessServiceId is not null) Services where Environment ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' order by ServiceId

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia visible para interpretar los cuadros tecnicos de performance.

options.content:
### Que muestra
Este tablero separa performance tecnica por CPU, RAM, storage, IOPS, red, latencia, throughput, errores y saturacion.

### Como interpretarlo
Picos altos y P95 alto indican consumo sostenido; errores y latencia altos indican degradacion de servicio; saturacion alta indica riesgo operativo. Si no hay datos, falta carga o rango para esa metrica.

### Accion sugerida
Empezar por Top Consumers And Outliers, confirmar la metrica afectada y revisar Threshold Breaches para priorizar remediacion.

panels.title: CPU Utilization
panels.description: CPU performance by resource and load identifier. Missing data means no CPU samples are available for the selected range.

panels.title: RAM Utilization
panels.description: Memory performance by resource and load identifier.

panels.title: Storage Utilization
panels.description: Storage performance by resource and load identifier.

panels.title: IOPS And Network
panels.description: IOPS and network indicators for operational bottleneck diagnosis.

panels.title: Latency Throughput Errors
panels.description: Application-style performance signals for end-to-end diagnosis.

panels.title: Saturation
panels.description: Saturation signal by resource and scenario.

panels.title: Average Peak P95
panels.description: Operational KPI table with average, peak, and P95 utilization.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, c.Environment, k.ResourceId, k.MetricName, k.AverageUtilization, k.PeakUtilization, k.P95Utilization from CapacityKpi k left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = k.ResourceId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = mr.Name and c.LoadId = k.LoadId where k.CapacityKpiId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' and coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) ~ '^(${HostName:regex})' order by k.P95Utilization desc, k.CalculatedAt desc limit 50

panels.title: Top Consumers And Outliers
panels.description: Highest consumers with ServiceId and ResourceId context for prioritizing operations work.

targets.rawSql: select m.ServiceId, coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, c.Environment, k.ResourceId, k.MetricName, k.AverageUtilization, k.PeakUtilization, k.P95Utilization, k.HeadroomAvailable from CapacityKpi k left join ServiceResourceMap m on m.ResourceId = k.ResourceId left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = k.ResourceId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = mr.Name and c.LoadId = k.LoadId where k.CapacityKpiId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' and coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) ~ '^(${HostName:regex})' and coalesce(m.ServiceId, '') ~ '^(${ServiceId:regex})' order by k.P95Utilization desc, k.PeakUtilization desc limit 20

panels.title: Threshold Breaches
panels.description: Warning and Critical conditions with resource/service severity context.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, r.ScopeId) as HostName, c.Environment, r.ScopeId as ResourceId, r.OverallRisk, r.Reason, r.CalculatedAt from RiskAssessment r left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = r.ScopeId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = mr.Name and c.LoadId = substring(r.RiskAssessmentId from '^(.+)-Risk-') where r.RiskAssessmentId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' and coalesce(mr.Name, r.ScopeId) ~ '^(${HostName:regex})' and r.OverallRisk in ('Warning','Critical') order by case r.OverallRisk when 'Critical' then 2 when 'Warning' then 1 else 0 end desc, r.CalculatedAt desc limit 50
